title: Credential category
description: A credential category from the European Digital Credentials credential vocabulary, represented as a restricted SKOS concept. The supported subset covers learning activities, higher-education diploma supplements, learning entitlements, and generic credentials.

id.description: The URI of the credential category in the European Digital Credentials vocabulary. The supported categories are: Lernaktivität (Learning Activity), Diplomzusatz (Diploma Supplement), Ansprüche auf Teilnahme an Bildungsmaßnahmen (Learning Entitlement), and Generisch (Generic).

inScheme.description: The European Digital Credentials credential vocabulary containing the category.
